# scripts/Interaction/ToolItem.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Interaction/ToolItem.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Frobbable rigid belt pickup transferring tool_id, count, and optional mesh
to player.inventory once, then queuing deletion. It cannot be carried.
PlayerFrob and PlayerCombat interpret the selected tool ID.

Base: `RigidBody3D`. Registered class: `ToolItem`.
